statement: (a) The cone of positive similitude forms of an integral step M of norm q is non-empty iff M is semisimple with all eigenvalues of modulus sqrt q, iff a compatible form has an invariant vacuum. (c) Both hypotheses are needed: M' = [[0,1],[-5,-2]] has a vacuum and negative definite W; B + 2B^{-T}, B = [[0,2],[1,0]], has eigenvalues +-sqrt 2, a vacuum, and every compatible W = 0.
